| `/spec/experiment/diagnostics/lanes/test_stop_at` | string, length ≥ 1 or null |  | diagnostic |  | Test hook stop point; null disables it. |
| `/spec/experiment/diagnostics/kernels` | object `KernelDiagnostics` |  | diagnostic |  | Kernel diagnostics. |
| `/spec/experiment/diagnostics/kernels/plugin_override` | string, length ≥ 1 or null |  | diagnostic |  | Plugin library to load instead; null keeps the configured one. |
| `/spec/experiment/diagnostics/kernels/poison` | one of `"off"`, `"zero"`, `"one"` |  | diagnostic |  | Fill pattern for uninitialized outputs. |
| `/spec/experiment/diagnostics/kernels/sweep_fast` | boolean |  | diagnostic |  | Shorten kernel sweeps. |
| `/spec/experiment/engine` | object `ExperimentEngine` |  | diagnostic |  | Lab-only engine diagnostics (amendment 11): flags the engine takes that are not serving configuration. Forbidden by the `production` profile with the rest of `spec.experiment`. |
| `/spec/experiment/engine/profile_ops` | one of `"on"` |  | diagnostic | `--profile-ops` / Config.profile_ops | Present means per-op device timing (`--profile-ops`). |
| `/spec/experiment/engine/debug_selection` | one of `"on"` |  | diagnostic | `--debug-selection` / Config.debug_selection | Present means the engine prints its selection table (`--debug-selection`). |
| `/spec/experiment/engine/deterministic` | one of `"on"` |  | diagnostic | `--deterministic` / Config.deterministic | Present pins placement to the plan the loader made (`--deterministic`). |
| `/spec/experiment/engine/kv_resident` | `positive` |  | diagnostic | `--kv-resident` / Config.kv_resident | Stream the sparse attention group's KV from host memory, resident tokens (`--kv-resident`). |
| `/provenance` | map `jsonPointer` → object `ProvenanceRecord` | yes | envelope |  | Map from a JSON Pointer to the record of where that value (and its descendants) came from; the root "" record is required (spec §7). |
| `/provenance/*` | object `ProvenanceRecord` | yes | envelope |  | Provenance of the value at the key's JSON Pointer. |
| `/provenance/*/origin` | one of `"schema_default"`, `"site"`, `"profile"`, `"cli"`, `"detected"`, `"derived"`, `"calibrated"`, `"experiment"` | yes | envelope |  | Input layer that set the value. |
| `/provenance/*/source` | string, length ≥ 1 | yes | envelope |  | Human-readable source: file and key, detector or derivation. |
| `/provenance/*/class` | one of `"policy"`, `"fact"`, `"derived"`, `"tuned"`, `"diagnostic"` | yes | envelope |  | Kind of value: operator policy, detected fact, derived, tuned (calibrated) or diagnostic. |
| `/provenance/*/lifecycle` | one of `"startup_only"`, `"step_boundary"`, `"live"` | yes | envelope |  | When the value may change: only at start-up, at a step boundary, or live. |
| `/provenance/*/confidence` | one of `"exact"`, `"measured"`, `"estimate"` | yes | envelope |  | Exact, measured or estimated. |
| `/provenance/*/inputs` | array of `jsonPointer` (0–) | yes | envelope |  | JSON Pointers of the values this one was derived from. |

## Shared types (`$defs`)

### `uint`

Unsigned integer within I-JSON's safe range. Type: integer 0..9007199254740991.

### `positive`

Positive integer within I-JSON's safe range. Type: integer 1..9007199254740991.

### `hex64`

64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Type: string, length ≤ 64, `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`.

### `digest`

`sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Type: string, length ≤ 71, `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`.

### `bdf`

PCI address, `dddd:bb:dd.f`, lowercase. Type: string, length ≤ 12, `^[0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-1][0-9a-f]\.[0-7]$`.

### `jsonPointer`

RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; "" is the root. Type: string, length ≤ 1024, `^(\|/(?:[^~/]\|~[01])*(?:/(?:[^~/]\|~[01])*)*)$`.

### `helperPatch`

A partial `helperCommon`: each present group is a nonempty partial field map (spec §2.2). Every member of `helperCommon`, each optional; a present group is nonempty.
